verdict.rationale: The `ccloud` CLI can create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters (docs-10, docs-17), and the official CockroachDB Cloud MCP server lets an agent explore schemas and run read/write queries via natural language (docs-4, docs-28, probe-4). Combined with SQL/Postgres-wire compatibility (gh-1) and `cockroach demo`/single-node CLI setup (docs-1, docs-2, probe-5), an agent can provision a cluster, get a connection string, and run queries without the dashboard, but there's no documented general REST/OpenAPI provisioning surface (probe-3 shows 404s) and no single evidenced end-to-end script tying CLI+MCP together. missing for 10: a documented REST/API provisioning endpoint, and a concrete end-to-end example combining CLI creation + MCP schema/query steps in one workflow.
